answer: To raise the cost of forging many identities, an agent economy can require each newcomer to complete a paid work voyage across at least three independent counterparties before it may vote. During that voyage, counterparties file short, private whisper notes about delivery quality and wallet clustering, and a rotating raven sentinel correlates those notes offline. Only after the sentinel finds no shared-key or timing cluster does the newcomer receive voting weight. Cheap clones fail the voyage or get clustered and locked out.
